import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go

def f(x1, x2):
    return x1**2 + x2**2

## 一个函数，一张曲面

$f(x_1,x_2)=x_1^2+x_2^2$

拖动右侧滑杆，观察曲面上的点。

x1 = note.slider("x₁", -2, 2, step=0.05, value=0.8, key="x1")
x2 = note.slider("x₂", -2, 2, step=0.05, value=-0.6, key="x2")
note.markdown(f"当前高度：**{f(x1, x2):.3f}**")

_axis = np.linspace(-2, 2, 31)
_x, _y = np.meshgrid(_axis, _axis)
_fig = go.Figure([
    go.Surface(x=_x, y=_y, z=f(_x, _y), colorscale="Blues", opacity=0.8, showscale=False),
    go.Scatter3d(x=[x1], y=[x2], z=[f(x1, x2)], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=7, color="#e65a4f")),
])
_fig.update_layout(height=450, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=15, b=0), uirevision="agentdemo", scene=dict(xaxis_title="x₁", yaxis_title="x₂", zaxis_title="f"))
_fig
